goal: Turn DeepSeek Code's partial outbound capabilities into one local-first, auditable, recoverable network control plane for model providers, web research, Browser, MCP, GitHub, SSH, and Scheduled Tasks.
description: The desktop Agent must allow useful online development workflows without leaking credentials, bypassing approval, losing evidence, or replaying unknown side effects. One main Agent remains the sole writer; read-only network workers return structured evidence.
tasks: Classify and authorize every outbound operation by capability, destination, risk, and approval grant
Route model streaming, web search/fetch, Browser, MCP HTTP, GitHub CLI/API, SSH tunnels, and scheduled executions through shared lifecycle events
Persist network grants, request evidence, usage, retries, cancellation, and indeterminate outcomes in SQLite
Provide per-domain allow-once, session, project, and deny controls with an inspectable UI
Support multiple web-search providers and content extraction without hard-coding one external service
Register SSH Tool Hosts into live Sessions while keeping model API keys and audit data local
Return GitHub PR, CI, and review results into the Verification Graph and repair workflow
Ensure Scheduled Tasks only run pre-authorized low-risk online actions and stop for new side effects
Provide network cost, latency, rate-limit, and failure observability with safe degradation
Recover safely after application, provider, MCP, GitHub, browser, or SSH failures
safety_requirements: Deny non-HTTP(S) and private-network web requests unless explicitly scoped to a local development target
Never persist API keys, OAuth tokens, SSH private keys, or unredacted authorization headers
Require approval for external domains, uploads, login, publishing, push, PR creation, and non-idempotent calls
Do not automatically replay indeterminate writes or network side effects
Enforce per-session budgets, output caps, redirect checks, rate limits, and cancellation
Record redacted request metadata and verification evidence for every network operation
integration_requirements: SQLite Event Store and Verification Graph
SwiftUI network access and evidence UI
Tool Registry, Permission Broker, Hook Runner, and Session Orchestrator
SSH Tool Host and local Browser Controller
